title: Multiplex SMP
description: A performance enhanced vanilla minecraft modpack used for the Multiplex-MC MSP
body:
Welcome to the official modpack for the Multiplex MC SMP server!

This lightweight, server-friendly modpack is built to preserve the core vanilla Minecraft experience while offering significant performance improvements for both clients and servers. Whether you're exploring, building, or engaging in multiplayer antics, you'll enjoy smoother gameplay without straying from the essence of Minecraft.
